story.iWant: to see my progress in each course as a progress bar on the dashboard
story.soThat: I can quickly understand my overall standing in each subject.
story.tasks: - Implement a `CourseProgressBar` component. - Fetch total and completed study sessions for each course. - Calculate course progress percentage. - Render a visual progress bar based on the calculated percentage. - Integrate `CourseProgressBar` component into the dashboard view. - Ensure real-time updates to `study_sessions` are reflected in course progress bars.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. The dashboard displays a progress bar for each course (AC2 from Tech Spec). - The progress bar accurately reflects the ratio of completed study sessions to total study sessions for that course.

artifact.snippet: The data model defines `courses` and `study_sessions` tables. The `courses` table stores course information, and `study_sessions` tracks individual study blocks, including their status, which is crucial for progress calculation.

constraint.description: Initial dashboard load, including all sessions for the upcoming month, should take less than 2 seconds, and course progress calculation should not degrade this performance.
UI updates after changing a task's status should feel instantaneous (< 200ms), and course progress bar updates should also be near-instantaneous.
All data fetching for course progress is subject to the RLS policies on the `courses` and `study_sessions` tables, ensuring users only ever see their own data.
The frontend should be able to handle temporary disconnects from the Supabase Realtime service and automatically re-subscribe, ensuring progress bars also update.
Log any errors during real-time subscription or data fetching/calculation for course progress.
Next.js Frontend direct integration with Supabase for data fetching and updates for course progress.
Adhere to Shadcn UI components for a consistent and modern aesthetic for progress bars.

tests.standards: Unit Tests: Test logic for calculating course progress based on completed and total study sessions. Component Tests: Test the `CourseProgressBar` component in various visual states (e.g., 0%, 50%, 100% complete) and edge cases. Integration/E2E Tests: Verify that real-time updates to `study_sessions` correctly impact the display and calculation of course progress bars on the dashboard. Security Testing: Ensure RLS policies are enforced when fetching data for course progress calculations.
